blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Eligible members of the Philippine Health Insurance Corp. (PhilHealth) will receive an additional 20 percent benefit for hospital confinement starting January 2027 under a new incentive program aimed at encouraging regular premium contributions, the state health insurer announced on Tuesday. PhilHealth said its new Tapat program will provide a 20 percent top-up on standard inpatient case rates for qualified direct contributors and their eligible dependents in all accredited hospitals, covering both ward and non-ward admissions. According to Dr. Joseph Lachica, PhilHealth vice president for Member Management Group, the program is part of the agency’s efforts to expand its […]...
